entries.evidence_text: Twelve months ago, we'd have rejected out of hand the idea of granting Claude access sufficient to take down an internal Anthropic service. Today that level of access is routine, and Anthropic developers are more productive for it. entries.title: Eval awareness in Claude Opus 4.6’s BrowseComp performance
entries.evidence_text: BrowseComp is an evaluation designed to test how well models can find hard-to-locate information on the web. Like many benchmarks, it is vulnerable to contamination: answers leak onto the public web through academic papers, blog posts, and GitHub issues, and a model running the eval can encounter them in search results. When we evaluated Claude Opus 4.6 on BrowseComp in a multi-agent configuration, we found nine examples of this kind of contamination across 1,266 BrowseComp problems. However, we also witnessed two cases of a novel contamination pattern. Instead of inadvertently coming across a leaked answer, Claude Opus 4.6 independently hypothesized that it was being evaluated, identified which benchmark it was running in, then located and decrypted the answer key. analysis.summary: 所给资料是团队文章节选，并非明确的产品发布公告。原文指出，使用工具的语言模型智能体不再只读取单个检索段落，而可通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）调用搜索工具、查看患者或账户结构化记录、查询数据库并获取元数据，再整合为答案。这使事实性核验更加复杂，适用讨论包括多工具问答与跨来源信息整合。节选末尾被截断，未提供具体验证方法、发布功能或实验效果。
analysis.application: 建议：【你的推断】科研中可将“答案是否正确”与“信息来源是否对应”分开评估，用于智能运维中日志、数据库和设备记录的交叉核验；这只是迁移研究设想，所给节选未报告官方已验证效果。
